s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent painful ulcerations with livedo pattern on lower limbs
salient_findings: Reticular purplish livedo pattern on both lower limbs
Multiple chronic, nonhealing ulcers on lower limbs
White atrophic scars on lower legs and ankles
key_facts: 31-year-old woman
4-year history of recurrent painful ulcerations
No personal or family history of vascular or autoimmune disease
No arthralgia or other dermatologic symptoms
No medications
No tobacco or illicit drug use
Reticular purplish livedo pattern on examination
Multiple chronic, nonhealing ulcers on lower limbs
White atrophic scars on lower legs and ankles
Lesional skin biopsy was performed

shortlist.label: Livedoid vasculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Reticular purplish livedo pattern and chronic, nonhealing ulcers on lower limbs

shortlist.label: Antiphospholipid syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent painful ulcerations and livedo pattern, possible thrombophilia

shortlist.label: Thrombophilia
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent ulcerations and livedo pattern, possible clotting disorder

shortlist.label: Immune-mediated vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Ulcerations and livedo pattern, possible autoimmune component

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic, nonhealing ulcers and livedo pattern, possible medium-vessel vasculitis

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of recurrent painful ulcerations, reticular purplish livedo pattern, and multiple chronic nonhealing ulcers on the lower limbs, along with the absence of personal or family history of vascular or autoimmune disease, is most consistent with livedoid vasculopathy. The lesional skin biopsy was also performed, which is a key diagnostic step for this condition.

rejected.label: Antiphospholipid syndrome
rejected.why: No personal or family history of vascular or autoimmune disease, and no mention of positive autoantibodies

rejected.label: Thrombophilia
rejected.why: The vignette does not provide evidence of a hypercoagulable state, and thrombophilia was excluded by negative coagulation studies in option C

rejected.label: Immune-mediated vasculitis
rejected.why: The patient denies arthralgia or other dermatologic symptoms, and there is no mention of systemic symptoms or positive autoantibodies

rejected.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
rejected.why: The patient's presentation is more localized to the skin, and there is no mention of systemic symptoms or involvement of other organs
